greeting: Hello, fellow pixel-pushers and plugin connoisseurs!
introParagraph: This week's Release Radar brings a solid mix of innovation and crucial fixes, proving that our favorite plugins are always working to keep our WordPress sites humming. From AI integrations to enhanced dashboard insights and much-needed stability improvements, there's plenty to unpack. Let's dive in and see what's new under the hood!

highlights.title: Charitable 1.8.13
highlights.summary: Charitable just got smarter! With new AI integration, you can now connect Claude or ChatGPT (via WPVibe or MCP) to build and restyle campaigns, making your fundraising efforts more dynamic and efficient than ever.

highlights.title: WP Mail SMTP 4.10.0
highlights.summary: Say hello to your new email command center! WP Mail SMTP now boasts a sleek new Dashboard page, offering a comprehensive overview of your email statistics, connection status, and a helpful setup checklist to ensure smooth email delivery.

highlights.title: Smash Balloon Social Post Feed 4.14.0
highlights.summary: No more stale feeds! Smash Balloon's Facebook plugin now provides a proactive admin notice and a weekly email report when your feed isn't fetching fresh content, ensuring your social presence always stays up-to-date and engaging.

highlights.title: Envira Gallery Lite 1.16.1
highlights.summary: Gallery woes begone! This update fixes frustrating block editor stalls and timeouts, especially for sites using remote media storage, ensuring your image management experience is as smooth as a freshly polished lens.
